page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right below the last line. Stains and ornaments at the edges are not printed text.

main_text.p: cernit hunc non illum actum liberum, & in eo situ vitali locat libertatem, quo illum actum liberum & non alium, quam qui quoad æter-nam futuritionem libertas erat liberrime pro-ductura, ita penes Dei providentiam est ut talis actus fit, non alius, non plures vel pauciores, & etiam penes voluntatem sed subordi-nate & dependenter, quod sint tales actus non plures vel pauciores.

6. Objici potest, si non poneretur tale decretum, necessitas futuritionis nulla esset, & maneret vera indifferentia naturalis, quia necessitas futuritionis est mere hypothetica, manans à libertate creata; quia enim libertas creata est libere hoc volitu-ra, ideo est futuri-tio æterna talis volitionis: nam posito, quod res sit futura, necesse est ut sit futura, sicut ne-cesse est res præsens, sit præsens: at vero in signo rationis futuritionem antecedente, libertas est absolute indifferens ad hoc vel illud volendum: quia vero est hoc non illud volitu-ra, ideo antecesit æterna futuritio. Resp. 1. contra omnem sanam rationem, libertas libere volens in tempore statuitur causa futuritionis æternæ. Nullum enim temporale est causa æterni, quia causa est prior effecto, temporale non est prius sed posterius æterno. 2. Concedimus necessitatem futuritionis esse tantum hypotheticam non absolutam, sed tamen est antecedens ne-cessitas respectu actus liberi, quod nobis sufficit ad probandum ne-cessitatem antecedentem non pugnare cum actu.

page.notes: The running head shows a mark between "DE" and "CRETI" that looks like an apostrophe or ornament; transcribed as "DECRETI". The page number reads as XII but is uncertain at this scan resolution. The catchword "actus" at the lower right is partly cut off and marked [?]. The left-margin vertical rule and the right-edge bracket-like mark are not printed text. The small mark at the lower left is a stain or signature-like mark and is not transcribed. Spellings "futuri-tio", "volitu-ra" and similar follow the printed line breaks with their hyphens. Original long s has been transcribed as plain s throughout, so "est" appears in the printed form "eft".
